author: UserSolrac
quote:
I chose to make this because the industry **** up this game and praised it endlessly, even nominating it for game of the year despite it not being out yet. 

The intro to this game is atrocious. Remember GTA IV you had to pick up your cousin and do a couple of errands for him? It was like that minus the humor and add in the annoying Yoga missions from GTA V to add salt to the wound.

The graphics are amazing, but I feel like that was the biggest focus driving this game and gameplay is secondary. The 30 FPS is also a big negative. A console that ran almost every game at 60FPS and championed that as the new standard can't even run this game at the standard. 

Poor optimization means that the game can stutter at times or cause glitches to occur.

Writing feels poor when compared to GTA IV or GTA V. The characters are not likeable. Niko was cold and calculating. Michael, Trevor, and Franklin all had their charm, but these two are written like a wet noodle.

There is one cool thing that I won't talk about much so I don't have to click the spoiler mark, but that was introduced nicely.

Overall I gave this game an overwhelming dislike because it did not meet the hype that the supposed critics gave it. I am also not one to write reviews because I feel that player numbers do a better service to a game's quality. Sadly, this one was one of the games I can honestly write off as a huge disappointment.
